name: SemText viewer
description: Render SemText .html documents from GitHub raw views in a sandboxed render jail.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src https: data:; font-src https:; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
